title: [AI Indie Game Promo] Pongu - Infinite Roguelike Breakout
author: Previous_Host_9990
selftext:
Hey y'all - I created this game entirely with AI. I just wanted a simple project to go all the way through the publishing process on [Itch.io](http://Itch.io) \- just getting my feet wet. But I do think it's a worthwhile play, has some elements of Balatro (exponential explosion of things) and Survivors (getting points for destroying stuff) but a much more compact experience. 

Would love any any all feedback. 

[https://nbd2.itch.io/pongu](https://nbd2.itch.io/pongu)

comments.author: ezoterik
comments.body: Nicely put together, although it is beyond me why it is labelled Roguelike. It seems to be the most abused tag in all of gaming.

comments.author: Previous_Host_9990
comments.body:
Thanks!

After each run you can purchase upgrades that assist in the next run. This mechanic only really matters if you're trying to beat Impossible difficulty - would need to beat easier difficulties many times and purchase many upgrades. 

Totally agree on the term losing meaning, I can easily remove that. Thank you!

comments.author: oniris
comments.body: Pretty novel, if such a thing can ever be novel, Arkanoid-like. NOT a roguelike.

replies.author: Previous_Host_9990
replies.body: Roguelike removed - can't change the post title but it's totally axed from the game. Thank you both.

comments.author: B0urBonx
comments.body: For a first full AI-built game on [Itch.io](http://Itch.io), this feels fun and surprisingly polished. Love the mix of Balatro/Survivors vibes in a smaller package. You should consider submitting it to [vibecodinglist.com](http://vibecodinglist.com), great exposure for unique builds like this!

replies.author: Previous_Host_9990
replies.body:
Thank you so much! Honestly very unexpected to get any kind of positive feedback like this. I'll definitely check out [vibecodinglist.com](http://vibecodinglist.com) 

One question I have - is it worth polishing this further, then trying to release on Steam? I have several other ideas that I've already started working on that are more substantial. But with another week or so focusing hereI could improve this game quite a bit - I don't think pacing is great, it could use more visual flair / tweaks, and the meta-progression could kick in earlier with other great power-ups like portals. 

If you have any thoughts would love to hear them. I really do not know what I'm doing.
